content.text: {"core": "Drive pushes forward, forcing motion toward a chosen point. In Discipline, it drives the slow solitary work — the patient tending that needs its own quiet pace. Overdone, the pushing outruns the tending: the practice gets whipped faster than it can hold, and the steady work breaks under the pace meant to serve it.", "sheetLine": "The pushing outran the tending; the quiet work cannot survive the speed."}
